new_value: HAL reset-cause clear support is already fully implemented. The implementation includes: (1) s_reset_cause_clear_proven flag in hal_reset.c that probes hwinfo_clear_reset_cause() on first snapshot call, (2) reset_cause_clear_supported field exposed in snapshot struct, (3) lichen_hal_reset_diagnostics_clear() that uses the proven flag to decide whether to call the real backend or return -ENOTSUP, and (4) test coverage in lichen/tests/hal/ and lichen/tests/hal_reset_unavailable/.
